dct_title_s: An improved topographical map of the northern & middle mines : compiled from the most recent & authentic surveys, showing a practicable route for the great Atlantic, & Pacific Railroad, through the Sierra Nevada at Fredonyers Pass. With a faithfull delineation of the course of rivers, mountain ranges, & location of cities, towns, roads, mines, &c.c
dct_alternative_sm: Map of the northern and middle mines
dct_description_sm: by M. Milleson, Cl. Engineeer ; engraved by H. Steinegger.
Relief shown by hachures and spot heights
Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Includes legend at lower left corner.
Shows topography, drainage, county boundaries, cities and towns, ranchos, public houses, bars, railroads, routes, e.g.: Carson Route.
"Entered according to Act of Congress in the Year 1854 by Alex. Zakreski in the Clerks Office of the Destreict Court of the United States for the Northern District of the State of California."
"For sale at all principal Book-Stores, and at Publisher's Office."
Tooley's dictionary of mapmakers, K-P: 257; Q-Z: 210, 428.
W-GR 265 ( Rep ). Wheat, 25 California Maps. Streeter 2765.

Stanford copy folded, in gray paper covered boards, 5 3/8"x 3 3/8", with printed title on front cover; in ink on front cover: "Keep 1854". On verso of front cover: "For Tirzah Jane". Stamp on verso of map: Post Office Literary Depot Gardiner & Kirk late Ourle Brothers Third St. Sacramento. Also, in ink, "Marquis C. Winchester In good health and Spirit"
dct_publisher_sm: published & lithd. by Alex. Zakreski, at the Topographical Drawning Office. Cor. Washington & Montgomery
